sql: with s(t, at) as (values ('KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-CEAS', timestamptz '2026-10-18 16:47:33'), ('KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-CEAS', timestamptz '2026-10-18 16:51:57'), ('KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT19-NQE', timestamptz '2026-10-19 01:58:25')) select s.t, (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t and x.at < s.at order by at desc limit 1) before, (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t and x.at between s.at + interval '25 min' and s.at + interval '45 min' order by at limit 1) m30, (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t and x.at between s.at + interval '55 min' and s.at + interval '90 min' order by at limit 1) h1, (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t and x.at between s.at + interval '3 hour' and s.at + interval '4 hour' order by at limit 1) h3, (select max(best_yes_bid) from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t and x.at > s.at) mx_after, (select best_yes_bid from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t order by at desc limit 1) last, (select max(at)::text from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=s.t) last_at from s
